formName: BCIA 8016 Request for Live Scan Service
formDescription: California DOJ form for requesting a Live Scan fingerprint background check.

questions.text: What is the contributing agency's ORI code?
questions.explanation: Enter the ORI code assigned by the Department of Justice for the agency requesting the background check.

questions.text: What is the authorized applicant type?
questions.explanation: Enter the type of applicant authorized by the agency for this Live Scan request.

questions.text: What is the type of license, certification, or permit?
questions.explanation: Enter the type of license, certification, or permit, or working title as assigned by the DOJ or agency.

questions.text: What is the name of the agency authorized to receive criminal record information?
questions.explanation: Enter the full name of the agency that is authorized to receive criminal record information from the Department of Justice.

questions.text: What is the contributing agency's mail code?
questions.explanation: Enter the five-digit mail code assigned by the DOJ for the contributing agency.

questions.text: What is the contributing agency's street address or P.O. Box?
questions.explanation: Enter the complete mailing address for the contributing agency, including street, city, state, and ZIP code as shown on the form.

questions.text: Who is the agency contact person?
questions.explanation: Enter the name of the contact person for the agency. This is mandatory for all school submissions.

questions.text: What is the agency contact's telephone number?
questions.explanation: Enter the telephone number for the agency contact person.

questions.text: What is the agency billing number?
questions.explanation: Enter the billing number assigned to the agency, if applicable.

questions.text: What is your first name?
questions.explanation: Enter your legal first name as it appears on your identification.

questions.text: What is your middle initial?
questions.explanation: Enter your middle initial, if you have one.

questions.text: What is your last name?
questions.explanation: Enter your legal last name as it appears on your identification.

questions.text: Do you have an alias or other name?
questions.explanation: Choose Yes if you have ever used another name, such as a maiden name or alias.

questions.text: What is your other last name?
questions.explanation: Enter your other last name, such as a maiden name or alias, if applicable.

autopopulate.profileDescription: User's other last name or alias

questions.text: What is your other first name?
questions.explanation: Enter your other first name, such as a maiden name or alias, if applicable.

autopopulate.profileDescription: User's other first name or alias

questions.text: What is the suffix for your other name?
questions.explanation: Enter the suffix for your other name, such as Jr., Sr., II, etc., if applicable.

autopopulate.profileDescription: Suffix for user's other name or alias

questions.text: What is your date of birth?
questions.explanation: Enter your date of birth in MM/DD/YYYY format.

questions.text: Sex:
questions.explanation: Select the option that best describes your sex as required on the official form.

questions.text: What is your driver's license number?
questions.explanation: Enter your current driver's license number as it appears on your license.

questions.text: What is your height?
questions.explanation: Enter your height in feet and inches (for example, 5'10").

questions.text: What is your weight?
questions.explanation: Enter your weight in pounds.

questions.text: What is your eye color?
questions.explanation: Enter your eye color as it appears on your identification.

questions.text: What is your hair color?
questions.explanation: Enter your hair color as it appears on your identification.

questions.text: What is your place of birth?
questions.explanation: Enter the state or country where you were born.

questions.text: What is your Social Security number?
questions.explanation: Enter your Social Security number. This information is used for identification purposes.

questions.text: What is your miscellaneous number?
questions.explanation: Enter any other identification number you may have, if applicable.

questions.text: What is your street address or P.O. Box?
questions.explanation: Enter your complete home address including street, city, state, and ZIP code as it should appear on the form.

questions.text: What is your number for this submission?
questions.explanation: Enter the number assigned to you for this submission, if applicable.

questions.text: Is this a resubmission?
questions.explanation: Choose Yes if you are resubmitting a prior Live Scan and need to provide the original ATI number.

questions.text: What is your original ATI number?
questions.explanation: Enter the ATI number from your original submission if you are resubmitting a Live Scan.

questions.text: What is the date you are signing this form?
questions.explanation: This field will be automatically filled with today's date as your signature date.

questions.text: What is your employer's name?
questions.explanation: Enter the name of your employer if required by the agency or statute.

questions.text: What is your employer's street address or P.O. Box?
questions.explanation: Enter your employer's complete address, including street, city, state, and ZIP code.

autopopulate.profileDescription: Employer Street Address or P.O. Box

questions.text: What is your employer's telephone number?
questions.explanation: Enter your employer's telephone number, if applicable.

questions.text: What is your employer's mail code?
questions.explanation: Enter the five-digit mail code assigned by the DOJ for your employer, if applicable.

questions.text: Level of Service:
questions.explanation: Select all applicable levels of service for this Live Scan request.
